'''Birkirkara Football Club''' is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in the town of [[Birkirkara]], on the island of [[Malta]]. The club was formed in 1950, following the amalgamation of Birkirkara United and Birkirkara Celtic. Birkirkara currently play in the [[Maltese Premier League]], which it has won on four occasions, most recently in the [[2012–13 Maltese Premier League|2012–13 season]].

Birkirkara is one of the founding members of the [[European Club Association]].<ref>{{cite news 
 |title=Agreement heralds new era in football 
 |url=http://www.uefa.com/uefa/keytopics/kind=4096/newsid=648350.html 
 |publisher=UEFA 
 |date=21 January 2008 
 |access-date=2008-01-21 
 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080127153016/http://www.uefa.com/uefa/keytopics/kind%3D4096/newsid%3D648350.html 
 |archive-date=27 January 2008 
 |url-status=dead 
 }}</ref>

The club also has a women's team.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Birkirkara FC Women's presented with the BOV Women's League trophy - The Malta Independent |url=https://www.independent.com.mt/articles/2020-07-03/football/Birkirkara-FC-Women-s-presented-with-the-BOV-Women-s-League-trophy-6736224819 |access-date=2024-09-08 |website=www.independent.com.mt}}</ref>"}}
